entities.summary: Elston Howard Turner Jr. is an American professional basketball player who last played for Iraklis Thessaloniki of the Greek Basket League. A 6'5", 211 lbs small forward who can also play as a shooting guard, Turner played for Washington Huskies and at Texas A&M Aggies before going overseas to Europe to play for several clubs in Italy, France, Germany and Greece.
